criteria_location: POSITION STATEMENT (about 50 lines, pp.2-3), split into two printed sub-headings: 'Intracranial Arterial Disease' and 'Extracranial Vertebral Artery Disease'. The flow-diverter anatomic criteria sit in an asterisk footnote immediately after the paragraph.
procedures_covered: Flow-diverting stent for large/giant wide-necked aneurysms
Mechanical embolectomy for acute ischemic stroke
Intracranial PTA +/- stent for atherosclerotic disease (investigational)

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: 'Have no evidence of intracranial hemorrhage or arterial dissection on CT or MRI imaging.' as one ALL item; 'not amenable to surgical treatment or standard endovascular therapy'.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Can receive endovascular mechanical embolectomy within 12 hours of symptom onset OR within 24 hours of symptom onset if there is evidence of a mismatch between specific clinical and imaging criteria; AND
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: OR with a conditional inside a single bullet of an ALL list; the 'specific clinical and imaging criteria' are not given.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: when surgical treatment is not appropriate AND standard endovascular techniques do not allow for complete isolation of the aneurysm, (e.g., wide-neck aneurysm of 4 mm or more, or sack-to-neck ratio less than 2:1).
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Examples (e.g.) nested in a criterion: unclear if the numbers are required or illustrative.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: that meet anatomic criteria* and are not amenable to surgical treatment or standard endovascular therapy.
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Asterisk footnote carries the actual numeric criteria and it is separated from the sentence by a blank line.

requirement_kinds.quote: Have a demonstrated occlusion within the proximal intracranial anterior circulation (intracranial internal carotid artery, or M1 or M2 segments of the middle cerebral artery, or A1 or A2 segments of the anterior cerebral artery)
wide-neck aneurysm of 4 mm or more, or sack-to-neck ratio less than 2:1
a size of 10 mm or more and a neck diameter of 4 mm or more
Have evidence of substantial and clinically significant neurological deficits (e.g. baseline (post-stroke) National Institutes of Health Stroke Scale (NIHSS) score)
Have evidence of salvageable brain tissue in the affected vascular territory (e.g. Alberta Stroke Program Early CT (ASPECTs) score)
device with FDA approval for the treatment of acute ischemic stroke
when surgical treatment is not appropriate

thresholds.quote: wide-neck aneurysm of 4 mm or more
a size of 10 mm or more
neck diameter of 4 mm or more

time_windows.quote: within 12 hours of symptom onset OR within 24 hours of symptom onset if there is evidence of a mismatch

Note 61635 (stent incl. angioplasty) has no '(Investigational)' tag although the position statement says intracranial PTA +/- stent for atherosclerosis is investigational.

extraction_hazards: Sub-headings 'Intracranial Arterial Disease' / 'Extracranial Vertebral Artery Disease' are plain lines.
Asterisk footnote '*(Flow-diverting stents are indicated ...' carries criteria and sits after a blank line.
Note paragraph before the first criterion limits scope ('not intended to address ... delayed cerebral ischemia').
Inline '(Investigational)' tags repeat on the following line in the CPT table (long descriptors wrap) so a code row spans 2-3 lines.
interesting_structures: Three body-system pathways plus two blanket investigational statements in one policy.
Clinical scales (NIHSS, ASPECTS) named without thresholds, with definitions that are only web links.
Code list tags disagree with position statement (61635).

fit_to_tree.why: Embolectomy is a clean ALL with five leaves, but two leaves (deficit severity, salvageable tissue) lack thresholds, a clinical-imaging 'mismatch' criterion is unspecified, and the footnote criteria must be joined to a different sentence.
